description: Shared deal rules (#809), read by scripts/deal_model.py (the CI content gate) and app/scripts/load-deals.mjs (the build), so both reject the same files. A deal is a discount the buyer pays for; it is never free and never labelled free.
free_wording_space_comment: Regex character-class body substituted for every {space} in free_wording_pattern. It is the union of JavaScript's \s and Python's str.isspace() plus zero-width characters, spelled out so Python (re.ASCII) and JavaScript (no u flag) match exactly the same strings and both fail closed on Unicode spacing such as '100\u00a0% off'.
promo_code_free_pattern_comment: Matched anywhere in promo_code, case-insensitive: codes have no word breaks (FREE, FREE50, BFFREE), so a code that names the deal free is rejected even inside a longer code. Deliberately strict: a code that merely contains a free word (FREEDOM50, CAREFREE) is rejected too; that false positive is accepted (fail closed). The last branch rejects codes that mean 100% off (100OFF, 100-OFF, 100_OFF, 100POFF, 100PCTOFF, 100PERCENTOFF, BF100OFF); the 100 must stand alone as a number, so 1000OFF and 2100OFF pass. Fixed-width lookbehind only: Python re (re.ASCII) and JavaScript (no u flag) read it the same way.
